summary: This week's AI news highlights significant advancements in AI technology, with a focus on personal AI agents, AI safety, and the increasing importance of AI in various industries. Mark Zuckerberg predicts billions of people will have personal AI agents in five years, while OpenAI and Anthropic continue to develop and improve their AI models.
insight: The development of personal AI agents is becoming a key area of focus for major tech companies, with potential applications in areas such as customer service, healthcare, and education.
highlights: Mark Zuckerberg predicts billions of people will have personal AI agents in five years

The use of AI in various industries is becoming increasingly important, with applications in areas such as customer service, healthcare, and education
